The Subtask Name: Determine the director with the earlier birth year between Spring Storms and Fun In The Barracks

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Conducted internet searches to gather information about the directors and their birth years for both films.
  -- Observation: Identified Fern Andra as the director of Spring Storms with a birth year of 1893 and Maurice Tourneur as the director of Fun In The Barracks with a birth year of 1876.
  -- Thought: Compared the birth years to determine which director was born earlier.
  -- Result: Determined that Maurice Tourneur (1876) was born earlier than Fern Andra (1893).
